description: PLACEHOLDER — defaults to break-even (= LCOE). Replace with a real planned tariff or avoided-cost figure for a meaningful ROI.
Annual growth rate applied to the tariff/revenue (0 = flat)
Year the battery and inverter replacement costs hit as a one-time outflow

Compound annual demand growth applied to the cash-flow's energy served (Energy(year n) = Energy(year 1) x (1+g)^(n-1)) — depends on population growth, income/economic growth, increasing connection rate, and productive-use uptake. Typical mini-grid range 3-8%/year; does not resize the physical PV/battery/generator system.
